description: Hand-labelled English retrieval queries over corpus.passages (ADR-0005). polish_only marks queries whose answer exists only in the Polish act (cross-lingual).

queries.query: what must be recorded when an unusual transaction is assessed but not reported
queries.rationale: AMLR 77(1)(b): "a record of the assessment ... whether or not such assessment results in a suspicious transaction report"; PL 34(3): "dokumentują ... wyniki bieżącej analizy przeprowadzanych transakcji".

queries.query: deadline to notify the FIU about a suspicious transaction in Poland
queries.rationale: "przekazywane niezwłocznie, nie później jednak niż w terminie 2 dni roboczych od dnia potwierdzenia ... podejrzenia".

queries.query: threshold for reporting cash transactions
queries.rationale: Threshold reports to the GIIF: "przyjętej wpłacie lub dokonanej wypłacie środków pieniężnych o równowartości przekraczającej 15 000 euro".

queries.query: human oversight of automated decisions
queries.rationale: Decisions from automated processes or AI systems must be "subject to meaningful human intervention to ensure the accuracy and appropriateness".

queries.query: record retention period
queries.rationale: AMLR 77(3): "shall be retained for a period of 5 years commencing on the date of the termination"; PL 49(1): "przechowują przez okres 5 lat".

queries.query: obligation to report suspicious transactions to the financial intelligence unit
queries.rationale: AMLR 69(1): "All suspicious transactions, including attempted transactions ... shall be reported"; PL 74(1): "zawiadamia Generalnego Inspektora o okolicznościach".

queries.query: prohibition on telling the customer that a suspicious transaction report was filed
queries.rationale: AMLR 73(1): "shall not disclose to the customer concerned ... that information ... has been transmitted"; PL 54(1): "zachowują w tajemnicy ... fakt przekazania Generalnemu Inspektorowi".

queries.query: must a suspicious transaction be held back until it has been reported
queries.rationale: AMLR 71(1): "shall refrain from carrying out transactions which they know or suspect ... until they have submitted a report"; PL 86(1) notification before execution.

queries.query: how long can the FIU suspend a transaction or block an account in Poland
queries.rationale: "żądanie wstrzymania transakcji lub blokady rachunku na okres nie dłuższy niż 96 godzin".

queries.query: maximum administrative fine for a bank breaching AML obligations in Poland
queries.rationale: For legal persons: "do wysokości równowartości kwoty 5 000 000 euro albo do wysokości 10 % obrotu".

queries.query: criminal penalty for failing to file a suspicious activity notification
queries.rationale: Failing to notify the GIIF "podlega karze pozbawienia wolności od 3 miesięcy do lat 5".

queries.query: deadline for submitting above-threshold transaction information
queries.rationale: "Instytucje obowiązane przekazują informacje w terminie 7 dni od dnia ... przyjęcia wpłaty lub dokonania wypłaty".

queries.query: which authority is the financial intelligence unit in Poland
queries.rationale: Organs of financial information are the finance minister and the "Generalny Inspektor Informacji Finansowej, zwany dalej „Generalnym Inspektorem”".

queries.query: is the Polish register of beneficial owners public
queries.rationale: The Central Register of Beneficial Owners article states: "Rejestr jest jawny."

queries.query: how often is the national money laundering risk assessment updated
queries.rationale: The GIIF reviews it and "nie rzadziej jednak niż co 2 lata, opracowuje krajową ocenę ryzyka".

queries.query: ongoing monitoring of transactions against the customer's risk profile
queries.rationale: "ongoing monitoring of business relationships ... to ensure that those transactions are consistent with ... risk profile".

queries.query: transaction value that triggers customer due diligence for occasional transactions
queries.rationale: AMLR 19(1)(b): "occasional transaction of a value of at least EUR 10 000"; PL 35(1): "o równowartości 15 000 euro lub większej".

queries.query: limit on cash payments for traders in goods
queries.rationale: "may accept or make a payment in cash only up to an amount of EUR 10 000".

queries.query: enhanced measures for politically exposed persons
queries.rationale: AMLR 42(1): "obtain senior management approval ... establish the source of wealth and source of funds"; PL 46(2): "uzyskują akceptację kadry kierowniczej wyższego szczebla".

queries.query: who in the institution is responsible for reporting suspicious transactions to the FIU
queries.rationale: AMLR 11(2): "The compliance officer shall also be responsible for reporting suspicious transactions to the FIU"; PL 8: designated manager transmits notifications under art. 74.
